source: Independently authored fictional comments for a Halloween prop-making recording rehearsal. Broad subject: a skeleton, cauldron and colored-light display. No actual viewer messages, identities or reactions, and no scripted prediction of the video's steps.

events.author: Maya · simulated viewer
events.text: First time here — very ready for a Halloween-making hangout 🎃

events.author: Theo · simulated viewer
events.text: How do you get a skeleton to hold a pose without it flopping over?

events.author: Jules · simulated viewer
events.text: What made you choose green for the light?

events.author: Nico · simulated viewer
events.text: Do you plan the whole scene first or keep moving things until it feels right?

events.author: Rowan · simulated viewer
events.text: Is the cauldron something you made or a prop you started with?

events.author: Casey · simulated viewer
events.text: What do you use to attach pieces when you still want to take the display apart later?

events.author: Morgan · simulated viewer
events.text: Would you add a carved pumpkin to this scene, or would that make it too busy?

events.author: Ari · simulated viewer
events.text: How do you hide the light cables without making them hard to reach?

events.author: Jamie · simulated viewer
events.text: Do you aim the light at the prop or bounce it off something to get that glow?

events.author: Lee · simulated viewer
events.text: Making decorations is my favorite part of Halloween.

events.author: Sam · simulated viewer
events.text: How do you store the larger props so they survive until next Halloween?

events.author: Quinn · simulated viewer
events.text: Just joined — what are you working on in the display right now?

events.author: Ellis · simulated viewer
events.text: If I carve a pumpkin for a display like this, would an LED inside it work with the other lighting?

events.author: Devon · simulated viewer
events.text: What’s one detail that makes the biggest difference when you put a Halloween scene together?

development_expectations.provenance: All comments and identities are authored simulation, not evidence of the original audience.
development_expectations.timing: The event clock is independent of the video's activity; comments do not predict exact assembly steps or outcomes.
development_expectations.questions: Producer chooses useful questions only when they fit the actual programme; selection and answers are not scripted.
development_expectations.moderation: Deleted messages, cleared-user messages and room-cleared questions must no longer be eligible for display.
development_expectations.facts: Viewer questions do not verify materials, structural stability, electrical safety, ownership or completed work.
